content.text: Raise £1.2m to grow Wickhatch and its hosted service, while the founder keeps control of the company's direction and the open-source project stays open for good.

content.title: Control

content.title: Amount and price

content.title: Valuation and price
content.text: The pre-money valuation of the Company is £4,800,000 on a fully diluted basis of 1,000,000 shares, including the Option Pool of 100,000 shares, giving a price of £4.80 per share (the Seed Price).
The company is valued at £4.8m before the money comes in. With 1,000,000 shares, including the option pool, each share costs £4.80. This is the "round price" used elsewhere.
A empresa é avaliada em £4,8 milhões antes do investimento. Com 1.000.000 de ações, incluindo o plano de opções, cada ação custa £4,80. É este o "preço da ronda" usado no resto do acordo.

content.title: Board
content.text: Three seats: the founder, an investor director and an independent chosen by the founder; any two directors make a quorum.

content.title: Board composition
content.text: The Board shall comprise three directors: the Founder, one director appointed by the Investor (the Investor Director), and one independent director appointed under clause 4.2. Any two directors form a quorum.
Three board seats: Ana Brindle, one Kestrel Row director and one independent. Any two directors make a quorum, so no single director can stop a meeting by staying away.

O conselho tem três lugares: Ana Brindle, um administrador da Kestrel Row e um independente. Bastam dois administradores para haver quórum, por isso nenhum administrador sozinho pode bloquear uma reunião faltando.

content.title: The independent director
content.text: The independent director shall be chosen by the Founder, and the Investor may object to a candidate only on reasonable grounds stated in writing.
Ana Brindle chooses the independent director. Kestrel Row can object only with a reasonable reason, in writing.
Ana Brindle escolhe o administrador independente. A Kestrel Row só se pode opor com um motivo razoável, por escrito.

content.title: Investor consents
content.text: 7 matters need the investor's consent; the open-source licence is outside all of them.

content.title: Investor consent matters
content.text: The Company shall not, without the prior written consent of the Investor, do any of the following 7 matters: changing the rights attached to any shares; creating a new class of shares; a Sale or a Listing; winding up the Company; borrowing more than £250,000 (other than the loan under clause 1.3); any transaction with the Founder outside the ordinary course of business; and amending the Articles in a way that affects the Seed Preferred Shares.
Kestrel Row's written agreement is needed for 7 big decisions, such as selling the company, creating new share classes or borrowing over £250,000. Day-to-day running stays with the company.

É preciso o acordo escrito da Kestrel Row para 7 decisões importantes, como vender a empresa, criar novas classes de ações ou pedir empréstimos acima de £250.000. A gestão do dia a dia continua com a empresa.

content.title: Licensing outside every consent
content.text: No consent right of the Investor, under this Agreement, the Articles or otherwise, extends to the licensing of Wickhatch or of any contribution to it, which remains governed by clause 12.
None of Kestrel Row's approval rights covers Wickhatch's open-source licence.
Nenhum dos direitos de aprovação da Kestrel Row abrange a licença de código aberto do Wickhatch.

content.text: Broad-based weighted average.

content.title: Anti-dilution
content.text: If the Company issues shares at a price below the Seed Price, the conversion price of the Seed Preferred Shares shall be adjusted on a broad-based weighted average basis, counting all issued shares and the Option Pool.
If a later round is priced lower, Kestrel Row is compensated in proportion to how many cheaper shares are issued, not as if its whole investment had been made at the lower price.
Se uma ronda futura tiver um preço mais baixo, a Kestrel Row é compensada na proporção das ações mais baratas emitidas, e não como se todo o investimento tivesse sido feito ao preço mais baixo.

content.title: Founder re-vesting
content.text: 15% of founder shares re-vest over one year.

content.title: Founder re-vesting
content.text: 15 per cent of the Founder's Ordinary Shares shall re-vest monthly over one year from Completion. Unvested shares are transferable at nominal value only if the Founder leaves voluntarily or is dismissed for cause, and vest in full on a Sale.
15% of Ana Brindle's shares are earned back month by month over one year. Ana Brindle loses unearned shares only on leaving by choice or being dismissed for cause; a sale vests them all.

15% das ações de Ana Brindle voltam a ser adquiridas mês a mês ao longo de um ano. Ana Brindle só perde as ações ainda não adquiridas se sair por vontade própria ou for despedida com justa causa; uma venda da empresa adquire-as todas.

content.text: A majority of ordinary shares, including the founder, can force a sale, at no less than the round price.

content.title: Drag-along
content.text: If the holders of a majority of the Ordinary Shares, including the Founder, approve a Sale, all shareholders shall sell their shares on the same terms, provided the price per share is not less than the Seed Price.
A sale of the whole company can be forced on every shareholder only if a majority of ordinary shares, including Ana Brindle, agree, and only at £4.80 a share or more.
Uma venda da empresa só pode ser imposta a todos os sócios se a maioria das ações ordinárias, incluindo Ana Brindle, concordar, e só a £4,80 por ação ou mais.

content.text: If at any time before a Sale or a Listing the Founder ceases to control a majority of votes at the Board, or ceases to hold a majority of the Ordinary Shares other than by the Founder's own transfer, the Founder may require the Investor to buy all of the Founder's shares at the Seed Price, by notice given within 24 months of that event.

If Ana Brindle loses control of the board or of the ordinary shares, other than by selling them, Ana Brindle can make Kestrel Row buy all of Ana Brindle's shares at £4.80 each, by asking within 24 months. The exit is when you sell control.

Se Ana Brindle perder o controlo do conselho ou das ações ordinárias, sem ser por as ter vendido, pode exigir que a Kestrel Row compre todas as ações de Ana Brindle a £4,80 cada, pedindo-o no prazo de 24 meses. A saída acontece quando se vende o controlo.

The balance of the Investment is made under clause 1.2.
Kestrel Row puts £600,000 into the company for 125,000 new shares at £4.80 each (rounded down to whole shares). The rest of the £1.2m buys existing shares from Ana Brindle, under clause 1.2.

A Kestrel Row investe £600.000 na empresa por 125.000 ações novas a £4,80 cada (arredondadas para ações inteiras). O resto dos £1,2 milhões compra ações já existentes a Ana Brindle, nos termos da cláusula 1.2.

content.text: On Completion the Investor shall purchase from the Founder 125,000 Ordinary Shares at £4.80 per share, an aggregate price of £600,000, and the Company shall redesignate those shares as Seed Preferred Shares on registration of the transfer.
Kestrel Row buys 125,000 of Ana Brindle's existing shares at £4.80 each, £600,000 in total. No new shares are issued for this part, so it does not dilute anyone.
A Kestrel Row compra 125.000 das ações que Ana Brindle já detém, a £4,80 cada, £600.000 no total. Esta parte não cria ações novas, por isso não dilui ninguém.

content.title: Founder loan to the Company
content.text: Within five Business Days of Completion the Founder shall lend the Company £400,000 from the proceeds of clause 1.2, unsecured, bearing interest at 4 per cent a year, repayable on a Sale, a Listing or the third anniversary of Completion, whichever is earliest.
Ana Brindle lends £400,000 of the sale money to the company within five working days. It earns 4% a year and is paid back on a sale, a listing or after three years, whichever comes first.

Ana Brindle empresta £400.000 do dinheiro da venda à empresa no prazo de cinco dias úteis. O empréstimo rende 4% ao ano e é reembolsado numa venda, numa entrada em bolsa ou ao fim de três anos, o que ocorrer primeiro.

Se a empresa for vendida ou liquidada, a Kestrel Row escolhe: recuperar primeiro o dinheiro investido, ou receber a sua parte da venda como os restantes sócios. Nunca as duas coisas.

Kestrel Row's written agreement is needed for 11 decisions: the 7 big ones, plus the yearly budget, senior hires, buying a business and large option grants.
É preciso o acordo escrito da Kestrel Row para 11 decisões: as 7 importantes, mais o orçamento anual, contratações de topo, a compra de uma empresa e grandes atribuições de opções.

Se uma ronda futura tiver um preço mais baixo, a Kestrel Row é compensada na proporção das ações mais baratas emitidas, e não como se todo o investimento tivesse sido feito ao preço mais baixo.

50% of Ana Brindle's shares are earned back month by month over three years. Ana Brindle loses unearned shares only on leaving by choice or being dismissed for cause; a sale vests them all.

50% das ações de Ana Brindle voltam a ser adquiridas mês a mês ao longo de três anos. Ana Brindle só perde as ações ainda não adquiridas se sair por vontade própria ou for despedida com justa causa; uma venda da empresa adquire-as todas.

Uma venda pode ser imposta a todos os sócios se metade das ações preferenciais e a maioria das ações ordinárias concordarem.

A Kestrel Row investe £800.000 na empresa por 166.666 ações novas a £4,80 cada (arredondadas para ações inteiras). O resto dos £1,2 milhões compra ações já existentes a Ana Brindle, nos termos da cláusula 1.2.

A Kestrel Row compra 83.333 das ações que Ana Brindle já detém, a £4,80 cada, £399.998,40 no total. Esta parte não cria ações novas, por isso não dilui ninguém.

Ana Brindle lends £200,000 of the sale money to the company within five working days. It earns 4% a year and is paid back on a sale, a listing or after three years, whichever comes first.

Ana Brindle empresta £200.000 do dinheiro da venda à empresa no prazo de cinco dias úteis. O empréstimo rende 4% ao ano e é reembolsado numa venda, numa entrada em bolsa ou ao fim de três anos, o que ocorrer primeiro.

If the company is sold, Kestrel Row gets its money back first and then also shares in the rest, until it has received three times what it paid.
Se a empresa for vendida, a Kestrel Row recupera primeiro o dinheiro e depois participa também no restante, até ter recebido três vezes o que pagou.

O Wickhatch continua em código aberto, sob a licença Apache-2.0. Nada neste acordo pode obrigar a empresa a fechá-lo ou a mudar a licença.

As duas partes dão garantias sobre os factos: a Brindlewood e Ana Brindle sobre a empresa; a Kestrel Row sobre os seus poderes, a origem do dinheiro e eventuais investimentos concorrentes.

Se uma garantia se revelar falsa, a responsabilidade de Ana Brindle tem um limite de duas vezes o montante investido, £2.400.000. As garantias da Kestrel Row têm o mesmo limite.

A Brindlewood envia à Kestrel Row as contas mensais, o orçamento anual e as contas auditadas, e responde a pedidos razoáveis no prazo de 10 dias úteis.

Kestrel Row buys 104,166 of Ana Brindle's existing shares at £4.80 each, £499,996.80 in total. No new shares are issued for this part, so it does not dilute anyone.
A Kestrel Row compra 104.166 das ações que Ana Brindle já detém, a £4,80 cada, £499.996,80 no total. Esta parte não cria ações novas, por isso não dilui ninguém.

content.title: Founder loan to the Company
content.text: Within five Business Days of Completion the Founder shall lend the Company £300,000 from the proceeds of clause 1.2, unsecured, bearing interest at 4 per cent a year, repayable on a Sale, a Listing or the third anniversary of Completion, whichever is earliest.
Ana Brindle lends £300,000 of the sale money to the company within five working days. It earns 4% a year and is paid back on a sale, a listing or after three years, whichever comes first.

Ana Brindle empresta £300.000 do dinheiro da venda à empresa no prazo de cinco dias úteis. O empréstimo rende 4% ao ano e é reembolsado numa venda, numa entrada em bolsa ou ao fim de três anos, o que ocorrer primeiro.

If the company is sold or wound up, Kestrel Row chooses: get its money back first, or take its share of the sale like everyone else. Not both.
Se a empresa for vendida ou liquidada, a Kestrel Row escolhe: recuperar primeiro o dinheiro investido, ou receber a sua parte da venda como os restantes sócios. Nunca as duas coisas.

content.title: Warranties

Both sides make promises about the facts: Brindlewood and Ana Brindle about the company; Kestrel Row about its authority, its money and any competing investments.
As duas partes dão garantias sobre os factos: a Brindlewood e Ana Brindle sobre a empresa; a Kestrel Row sobre os seus poderes, a origem do dinheiro e eventuais investimentos concorrentes.

content.title: Limits on claims (indemnity cap)
content.text: The aggregate liability of the Founder under the Warranties and any indemnity under this Agreement shall not exceed the amount invested by the Investor, being £1,200,000, and the liability of the Investor under its Warranties is limited on the same basis.
If a promise turns out to be wrong, Ana Brindle's liability is capped at £1,200,000, the amount invested. Kestrel Row's promises are capped the same way.
Se uma garantia se revelar falsa, a responsabilidade de Ana Brindle tem um limite de £1.200.000, o montante investido. As garantias da Kestrel Row têm o mesmo limite.

content.title: Information to the Investor
content.text: The Company shall provide the Investor with monthly management accounts within 20 days of each month end, the annual budget 30 days before each financial year, audited accounts within 120 days of each year end, and such other information as the Investor reasonably requests, on 10 Business Days' notice.
Brindlewood sends Kestrel Row monthly accounts, the yearly budget and audited accounts, and answers reasonable requests within 10 working days.
A Brindlewood envia à Kestrel Row as contas mensais, o orçamento anual e as contas auditadas, e responde a pedidos razoáveis no prazo de 10 dias úteis.

content.title: Information to the Company
content.text: The Investor shall provide the Company and the Founder with the extract of its quarterly fund report relating to the Company, notice within 10 Business Days of any investment in a business competing with the Company, notice of any intended transfer of its shares, and such other information as the Company reasonably requests, on 10 Business Days' notice.

Kestrel Row shares what its fund reports say about the company, tells Brindlewood within 10 working days if it invests in a competitor, gives notice before selling its shares, and answers reasonable requests within 10 working days.

A Kestrel Row partilha o que os relatórios do fundo dizem sobre a empresa, avisa a Brindlewood em 10 dias úteis se investir num concorrente, avisa antes de vender as ações que detém e responde a pedidos razoáveis no prazo de 10 dias úteis.

Cada parte paga a própria equipa. As tarefas partilhadas na sala do negócio são divididas a meias. A Kestrel Row paga as perguntas de diligência que fizer.

Cada cláusula tem uma versão simples em inglês e em português. Se forem diferentes, a versão simples diz o que as partes quiseram.

A clause that contradicts a signed understanding is void, and no version containing it may be signed until both parties sign again.
When both lawyers sign "this is our understanding", the drafting must follow it. A clause that contradicts it does not count, and that version cannot be signed until both sides sign again.
